audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows disagreed with their own why text: rows 0 and 1 said Camille while whys[0]/whys[1] call level 1-2 close to even; rows 3 and 5 said Skill while whys[3]/whys[5] say Camille owns them; row 6 said Camille while whys[6] and the late paragraph say Kayle flips it.
audit.why: Camille has no wall-dash engage at level 1 and Hookshot is not ranked yet, so the first two levels are even; at 16 Kayle's AoE waves out-DPS Tactical Sweep's heal and Camille cannot dive her.
audit.corrected: Rows 0/1 to Skill, rows 3/5 to Camille, row 6 to Kayle, both layers, with ratings adjusted.

audit.why: spikes[] map her level 2-3 engage, her level-6 cage, her Sheen first item and Kayle's level-16 form; the mirror audit already credited Divine Ascent for the range spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hookshot was repeatedly called a stun; Riot's text says it knocks up. Nothing said the grapple needs a wall, and nothing warned that Radiant Blast's resistance shred is worthless against Precision Protocol's true damage, or that Tactical Sweep heals.
audit.why: A knock-up and a stun behave differently for tenacity and for Kayle's own casts. Hookshot needs terrain, so fighting in open lane removes her engage entirely. Q's recast is true damage, so armour and MR — and Kayle's own shred — do nothing against it.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block, dosFull[0], dosFull[2] and both donts rewritten with the knock-up, the 16s cooldown, the wall requirement, the true-damage note and the anti-heal call.
